en.title: 26 U.S.C. §42(e)(3)(B) refers to “subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii)”, which no longer exists
en.summary: Section 42(e)(3)(B) sets the credit for certain rehabilitation expenditures “using the percentage applicable under subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii)”. Subsection (b)(2)(B) has had no clauses since P.L. 110-289 §3002(a) restructured subsection (b); the 30 percent rule is now in subsection (b)(1)(B)(ii). The reference was not conformed when subsection (b) was rewritten.

summary.en: In release point 119-134 of the United States Code, the reference carries a footnote and a References in Text note: subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii) was redesignated subsection (b)(1)(B)(ii) in 2008. The wording of the section is unchanged.

responses.after: the credit under this section for such rehabilitation expenditures shall be determined using the percentage applicable under subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii).¹ Footnote ¹: “See References in Text note below.” References in Text note: “Subsection (b)(2)(B)(ii), referred to in subsec. (e)(3)(B), was redesignated subsec. (b)(1)(B)(ii) of this section, and amended, by Pub. L. 110-289, div. C, title I, § 3002(a)(1), (2)(C), July 30, 2008, 122 Stat. 2879.”
